app.title: 悠长的假期
app.subtitle: A holiday with no to-do list
app.tagline: A quiet Alpine yard. Feed grass, walk the llama, or do nothing. Expressions arrive on their own.
menu.hint:
Touch or mouse: tap lawn to walk, grass to pick up, llama to interact.
WASD to walk, Space to interact, Esc to pause.
hud.hint: Tap lawn to walk · grass to pick up · llama to feed / lead
hud.hint.default: Tap lawn to walk · grass to pick · llama to feed / lead
hud.hint.leading: Tap the action button or the llama to release.
hud.hint.carrying: Tap the llama to feed, or use the action button.
hud.hint.near_grass: Walk to the grass · Space to pick up
hud.hint.near_llama: Near the llama · Space to feed or lead
hud.hint.near_pond: Near the pond · Space to cast a line
hud.hint.fishing: Line in the water. Wait quietly.
hud.hint.fish_bite: Something tugged! Press to reel in.
hud.hint.plant_empty: Soft soil here · Space to plant
hud.hint.plant_water: It needs water · Space to water
hud.hint.near_animal: Near an animal · Space to give it a moment
hud.hint.carrying_fish: Holding a fish · go near a duck or goose to toss it
pause.title: A pause
confirm.heading: Leave for now?
confirm.restart: The yard will wake again. Polaroids stay in the journal.
confirm.title: The holiday waits behind the door.
album.title: Polaroid journal
notice.arrive: The wind is light. You leave the bag by the door.
notice.first_hint: Try picking up some grass, casting a line at the pond, or saying hello to an animal.
notice.hint.go_fish: The pond is quiet over there — fancy casting a line?
notice.hint.go_pet: The animals are drifting about. Walk up to one and say hello?
notice.hint.go_plant: That small patch of soil is still empty — walk over and plant something?
notice.hint.go_grass: The grass pile is still by the door. Bring some to the llama?
notice.hint.go_explore: You haven't been to the right side yet. Take a look?
notice.new_day.a: A new day. The dew hasn't quite dried.
notice.new_day.c: Another day. The yard is still.
notice.picked_grass: A bundle of grass in your hand.
notice.fed_llama: It sniffs, and does not leave at once.
notice.lead_start: The llama follows you across the grass.
notice.lead_stop: The lead drops. It returns to its own day.
notice.pet.cow: The cow tilts its head and stays.
notice.pet.horse: The horse lowers its head gently.
notice.fishing.cast: The line drops into the water. Wait a little.
notice.fishing.wait: Still waiting. The water is patient too.
notice.fishing.bite: A tug on the line — reel in!
notice.fishing.caught: You caught one. Small and bright.
notice.fishing.caught.medium: A heavier catch. It pulled well.
notice.fishing.caught.odd: A peculiar one. It stared at you, then slipped away.
notice.fishing.miss: It got away. That is fine.
notice.fishing.release: It flicked its tail and slipped back into the water.
notice.toss_fish.goose: The goose took it. No thanks given.
notice.plant.planted: Pressed into the soil. It needs time.
notice.plant.watered: Watered. The roots can feel it.
notice.plant.bloomed: It bloomed while no one was watching.
notice.plant.bloomed_notice: It bloomed. Nothing to do but look.
notice.plant.harvested: The flower came away gently. A warmth left in the soil.
photo.llama_annoyed.title: Overcast annoyance
photo.llama_annoyed.note: When the goose comes close, the ears go first.
photo.llama_happy.title: A real smile in the sun
photo.llama_happy.note: A sheep approaches and the ears go soft.
photo.llama_smirk.title: Off the clock
photo.llama_smirk.note: Cow and horse finally have nothing to do but graze. The llama gives them a sideways grin: 'Even you two get a holiday.'
photo.llama_fed.title: After the right grass
photo.llama_fed.note: A short gentleness, then ordinary again.
photo.duck.title: Pond chorus
photo.duck.note: The ducks do not explain. They drift.
photo.cow.title: The cow, once
photo.cow.note: It almost never performs. That is why this one is quiet.
photo.sheep_pet.title: A small proximity
photo.sheep_pet.note: You reached out. It did not move away.
photo.plant_bloom.title: While no one watched
photo.plant_bloom.note: It took a few days and the right amount of water. Then one morning, it was simply there.
photo.fish_catch.title: Caught
photo.fish_catch.note: The pond was quiet for a long time. Then it wasn't.
photo.cow_pet.title: The cow's expression
photo.cow_pet.note: You reached out. It just stood there, not walking away.
photo.horse_pet.title: The horse lowers its head
photo.horse_pet.note: On a sunny afternoon, quietly, it bowed its head.
tuning.title: Holiday tuning
tuning.subtitle: These knobs change pace, never chores.
tuning.gameplay.expression_cooldown.desc: How long before the same face can return.
tuning.player.lead.description: Slower still while walking the llama.
tuning.enemies.goose.description: On gray days the goose enters other spaces more.
tuning.environment.zoom.description: A slight push of the fixed panorama.
tuning.local_failed: Could not save; changes stay in this preview.
tuning.local_ready: Changes save as a local preview draft.
notice.cannot_walk: No footing here. Stay on the lawn inside the yard.
